why: No nightly rate dated 2024 or later anywhere, read 2026-10-30: the operator domain pelicancayrvpark.com is hijacked (Indian rummy/teen-patti gambling spam; Wayback shows the takeover from April 2026, and only bot-blocked 403s 2022-2025); the RoverPass listing (Pelican Cay Harbor Camping & Marina, updated 11/15/2024) is unclaimed with no rates and no booking button; the only rate anywhere is a $56 RV Life review from 1/2021. It also looks like a long-stay park: a 12/2021 RV Life reviewer was told it accepts only applications from long-term residents (long-stay test 2), and a 2020 manufactured home at the park's own address (299 Morris Ave, 'Monroe Park' subdivision, $1,400 association fee covering utilities, MLS A12083237) is listed for sale at $59,000 (test 5).
name: Pelican Cay RV Park
flags: Google Maps (gm.py 2026-10-30) has it open as Pelican Cay RV Park LLC, 3.7/107, phone 305-563-0745, still linking the hijacked domain; marinas.com and RoverPass give 305-451-5223. A Google presence alone can't stand in for the missing rate or show that nights are for sale.

Esri satellite at the Google pin (2026-10-30, rendered) shows trailers and park models packed nose-to-tail on narrow dredged-canal fingers beside a boatyard off US-1 by Manatee Creek, reading as a permanent/long-stay park rather than a transient RV park. No waterfront audit was done because the park is a skip; any water there is canal or creek, not open bay.
Older marinas.com reviews (2010, 2011) are poor (8 crowded sites, rental RVs with mold and roaches). The Google review text was not read.
If AWH wants it reconsidered, the only way to get a rate, and to find out whether it sells nights without an application, is to call the park.
